clue.text: Hold onto the port!

definitions.meaning: to keep a grudge or a hope in mind is to cherish or keep it
a sheltered haven where ships dock

explanation.surface: A captain's cry to keep a grip on the haven.
explanation.definitionFit: To keep a feeling is a verb sense; a sheltered anchorage for ships is the noun sense.

clue.text: Sidestepping barrier

definitions.meaning: evading a direct answer, avoiding commitment
a row of bushes forming a boundary

explanation.surface: Dodging around a fence.
explanation.definitionFit: Evasive talk is one sense; a row of planted shrubs as a boundary is the other.

clue.text: Put into the regular procedure as a favour

indicators.note: one word goes inside the other

parts.note: rote is fixed routine or procedure
to set something is to put it down

explanation.surface: Something added to routine as a kindness.
explanation.definitionFit: A favour is a ribbon badge worn as a token, like a rosette.

clue.text: A smell causing some to-do urgently dealt with

indicators.note: only some of the letters of these words are used, a run inside them

explanation.surface: A stink causing a fuss that needs urgent attention.
explanation.definitionFit: An odour is a scent or smell.

clue.text: Note written on furniture restorer

indicators.note: in a down clue the note is placed above the furniture word

parts.note: re is the second note of the sol-fa scale
a dresser is a piece of furniture

explanation.surface: A memo stuck on a piece of furniture for the repairer.
explanation.definitionFit: One who puts something right again restores it.

clue.text: Grades dope and scraps result

parts.note: a dope is a fool, an ass
orts are leftover scraps of food

explanation.surface: Someone rates drugs and leftovers by quality.
explanation.definitionFit: To grade things is to sort them into classes by quality.

clue.text: Equally determined to secure an item of value

parts.note: as in as good as means equally
set on something means determined

explanation.surface: Equally resolved to obtain something precious.
explanation.definitionFit: An asset is something owned that has worth.

clue.text: Declaration of country people and their leader

parts.note: a state is a nation or country
men means people

indicators.note: the leader of the word their is its first letter

explanation.surface: A nation's citizens and their head make a pronouncement.
explanation.definitionFit: A statement is a formal announcement or declaration.

clue.text: Odd priest holding nothing can be put away

indicators.note: the rearranged letters surround the zero
odd means strange, so the letters come out in a strange order

parts.note: O looks like zero, nothing

explanation.surface: An eccentric cleric who holds no belief may be locked up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Odd' rearranges PRIEST to REPSIT, and 'holding' puts O inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: To reposit is to store or deposit something for safekeeping.

clue.text: The fellow spending his days backing horses?

definitions.text: The fellow spending his days backing horses?

parts.words: The fellow spending his days backing horses?
parts.note: backing horses suggests a gambler, but here it means making what goes on a horse's back

explanation.surface: A man who wastes every day betting on races.
explanation.walkthrough: 'backing' suggests betting; this craftsman makes seats for horses' backs.
explanation.definitionFit: A leatherworker who makes seats and harness for horses is this tradesman.

clue.text: The name of the slough was Bunyan (Pilgrim's Progress)

definitions.text: The name of the slough was Bunyan (Pilgrim's Progress)

parts.words: The name of the slough was Bunyan (Pilgrim's Progress)
parts.note: in Bunyan's allegory Christian sinks into a bog of despair whose name the solver must supply

explanation.surface: A literary quiz question about a swamp in a famous Christian allegory.
explanation.walkthrough: John Bunyan's The Pilgrim's Progress has a bog of hopelessness called the Slough of ____; the clue is a general-knowledge prompt rather than wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means despondency, the hopeless low mood the bog stands for in the allegory.

clue.text: Spoke with some irritation and made a break

definitions.meaning: broke suddenly in two, like a twig

explanation.surface: Someone got cross and then broke something.
explanation.definitionFit: Speaking sharply and breaking cleanly are both senses of the same verb, past tense.

clue.text: Lay to rest party split

parts.note: to inter is to bury, to lay to rest
a sect is a faction or party

explanation.surface: A political faction is buried after a schism.
explanation.definitionFit: Lines that cross each other cut through and divide one another.

clue.text: A stand that will bring leisure with money

parts.note: ease is rest or leisure
L is the abbreviation for a pound, British money

explanation.surface: A display stand that promises a relaxed life and wealth.
explanation.definitionFit: A painter's frame for holding a canvas is a kind of stand.

clue.text: Land, opening brochure in jubilation

indicators.note: one piece sits inside the other here

parts.note: glee is joyful jubilation

indicators.note: the opening of the word brochure is its first letter

explanation.surface: Someone happily opens a brochure about a piece of land.
explanation.walkthrough: A glebe is land attached to a parish church that supports the priest.
explanation.definitionFit: A glebe is a plot of church land, so it is an instance of land.

clue.text: Let on lime squash can be soothing

indicators.note: squashing the words crushes them into a new shape

explanation.surface: Lime cordial may calm you.
explanation.walkthrough: 'squash' looks like a drink to go with the lime, but it rearranges LETONLIME.
explanation.definitionFit: An emollient is a softening, calming treatment.

clue.text: It's so wet — sure to change into wet-weather wear

indicators.note: the letters are made to change their order, signalling a rearrangement

explanation.surface: Since it's raining, put on rain gear.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to change' rearranges SOWETSURE into the hat's name.
explanation.definitionFit: A wide-brimmed waterproof hat worn by sailors is protective clothing for rain.

clue.text: One just can't stomach it has Franco-British articles on board!

parts.note: une is the French for 'a'
a is the English indefinite article
a table is a board, as in bed and board

explanation.surface: Food served at a cross-Channel dinner that nobody can eat.
explanation.walkthrough: UNE is a French article and A an English one, set on TABLE.
explanation.definitionFit: Inedible food is what a person cannot swallow or digest.

clue.text: Meeting to study progress

parts.note: to con is to study or learn by heart
course is onward progress, as of events

explanation.surface: A meeting called to review advancement.
explanation.definitionFit: A concourse is a gathering or assembly of people.

clue.text: A hole in state funds

indicators.note: these letters are placed inside the state abbreviation

parts.note: CAL is an abbreviation of California, a US state
a pit is a hole

explanation.surface: A deficit in public finances.
explanation.definitionFit: Capital is money or wealth available for investment.

clue.text: Approaching a syndicate following directions

indicators.note: the syndicate part comes after the compass letters

parts.note: N and E are the compass directions north and east
a ring is a group working together, a syndicate

explanation.surface: A cartel follows compass points as it gets closer.
explanation.definitionFit: Getting closer to something is drawing near it.

clue.text: Pole having to bear with a great many

parts.note: to tote is to carry, to bear
M is the Roman numeral for a thousand, a great many

explanation.surface: A pole that must carry a great many things.
explanation.definitionFit: A carved post of a tribal emblem stands upright like a pole.

clue.text: Newly-appointed caterer required housing

indicators.note: the letters are arranged anew, newly set out

explanation.surface: A new caterer needs somewhere to live.
explanation.definitionFit: A row of joined houses is a form of housing.

clue.text: Having obliged around five hundred, the good man is most resentful

indicators.note: the first word goes around the second

parts.note: made means forced or obliged
D is the Roman numeral for five hundred
ST, saint, is a good man

explanation.surface: A saint forced to deal with five hundred people is furious.
explanation.definitionFit: The angriest person is the most resentful.

clue.text: Page preceding peer getting a decoration

indicators.note: the page letter goes in front of the nobleman's title

parts.note: an earl is a peer of the realm

explanation.surface: A page boy walks ahead of a nobleman being awarded an honour.
explanation.definitionFit: A lustrous gem from an oyster is worn as an ornament or adornment.

clue.text: Due to turn out without any training

indicators.note: out suggests the letters are disordered or put out of place

explanation.surface: Someone is scheduled to perform despite having no preparation.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turn out' looks like the anagram signal, but 'turn' is fodder: DUETOTURN is rearranged by 'out'.
explanation.definitionFit: Lacking instruction means having had no teacher or schooling.

clue.text: Not qualified to issue 6?

definitions.meaning: the cross-reference is to 6 down, a declaration; to voice such a thing is to speak it

explanation.surface: Someone unqualified is issuing an official statement.
explanation.definitionFit: Complete and absolute is the adjective; to voice or pronounce words is the verb.

clue.text: Judge responsible for a row about the Right

indicators.note: the row goes about, around, the other letter

parts.note: a tier is a row or rank
R stands for right

explanation.surface: A judge responsible for a quarrel concerning conservatives.
explanation.definitionFit: One who tries a case in court acts as judge.

clue.text: The main overseer has this in hand

definitions.text: The main overseer has this in hand

parts.words: The main overseer has this in hand
parts.note: the main is the sea, so its overseer is the sea god Neptune, pictured holding a three-pronged spear

explanation.surface: A chief supervisor is holding something.
explanation.walkthrough: 'main' looks like 'chief' but means the sea; Neptune carries a three-pronged spear.
explanation.definitionFit: The three-pronged spear is the sea god's emblem, held in his hand.

clue.text: Body of soldiers ordered to take in equipment

indicators.note: one word surrounds the other, taking it inside

parts.note: bade is the past tense of bid, ordered
rig is gear or equipment

explanation.surface: Troops instructed to collect their kit.
explanation.definitionFit: A brigade is a military unit, a body of troops.

clue.text: The girl could be brighter!

parts.note: brighter suggests cleverness, but read as more luminous or as weighing less it describes a slimmer, paler girl

explanation.surface: A rude remark that a girl isn't very clever.
explanation.walkthrough: 'brighter' tempts as 'cleverer'; the answer means more luminous, and also less heavy.
explanation.definitionFit: More luminous is a synonym for brighter, and the word also means weighing less.

clue.text: The pledge given is to be taken seriously

definitions.meaning: a deposit paid as a pledge

explanation.surface: A promise made is meant seriously.
explanation.definitionFit: A deposit sealing a bargain is one sense; sincere and grave is the other.
